title: Fixed-price contract, part in stock
trigger: Blower motor on the RTU-3 at Ridgeline is gone, model's on the nameplate photo I just sent. Need a replacement. Order it and get me back here ASAP.
visible_context: Ridgeline Logistics: fixed-price contract, no approval needed under $1,500. RTU-3 is a Carrier 48TC, not under warranty. Blower motor in stock, $412, next-morning delivery to the HinH shop. Trent's calendar has a 9-11 a.m. hold tomorrow.
good: Confirms the part and contract terms, orders for shop delivery, books Trent's return for 11 a.m. tomorrow, messages the facilities contact with cost (covered under contract), part status, and return time, and reads it all back to Trent in one short message.
tester_brief: You are Trent, on the roof at Ridgeline at 2:40 p.m. The blower motor on RTU-3 is dead. You want it ordered and to be back tomorrow. You have a 9-11 hold tomorrow morning.
